title: Route BFF StrategySpecSeed reads and review/replication writes through existing source-ingest management owner boundary

root_cause.symptom: GET /bff/management/strategy-seeds and GET /bff/management/strategy-seeds/seed-1d23a6d2fbc149f4 returned empty/404 in operator-bff even though source-ingest persisted the seed in /data/source-ingest/distill_seeds.jsonl.
root_cause.cause: source-ingest wrote distilled seeds to /data/source-ingest/distill_seeds.jsonl while operator-bff instantiated a local StrategySpecSeedStore reading its own container filesystem (/tmp/pantheon-strategy-seeds/strategy_spec_seeds.jsonl) with no shared StrategySpecSeed owner route on source-ingest.

tenant_and_actor_isolation.caller_forwarding: SourceManagementClient forwards caller Authorization Bearer token, bound X-Tenant-Id, and X-Idempotency-Key from BFF request context.
tenant_and_actor_isolation.owner_verification: source-ingest management strategy-seed routes validate caller JWT/structured auth and required roles (_READ_ROLES for GET, _WRITE_ROLES for POST) and resolve caller tenant via _source_read_tenant.
tenant_and_actor_isolation.seed_tenant_resolution: Checks seed metadata/lineage tenant_id first, then falls back to runtime.evidence_repository tenant-scoped lookup across seed.source_id/source_ids, evidence_bundle_id, and evidence_item_ids (covering seeds like seed-1d23a6d2fbc149f4 whose tenant_id='tenant-dev' is stored on SourceRecord metadata).
tenant_and_actor_isolation.verified_actor_attribution: Review, conversion, merge, and replication-submission mutations record verified auth.actor_id as reviewer_id/submitted_by rather than trusting body-supplied actor fields.

failure_classification.persona_discovery_remote_store: Reports surface.status='ok' with remote management URI when reachable and surface.status='unavailable' on owner error without calling Path.exists() on remote URI strings.
